Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:

  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task

Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt cap is reached, and
reaching the cap is charged the full cap. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

n=20
src=[[1]*n for _ in range(n)]
src[0][8]=2
coords=[(7,c) for c in [4,5,6,11,12,13]]+[(8,c) for c in [6,11]]+[(9,c) for c in [6,7,9,10,11,12]]+[(10,c) for c in [6,7,8,9,12,13]]+[(11,c) for c in [5,6,9]]+[(12,c) for c in [4,5,9]]+[(13,c) for c in [8,9,10,11,12,13]]
for r,c in coords: src[r][c]=7
# Split around the marker column. Move each side to its corresponding top corner; retain the marker-column 7s and extend its 2-ray.
out=[[1]*n for _ in range(n)]
center=8
left=[(r,c) for r,c in coords if c<center]
right=[(r,c) for r,c in coords if c>center]
mid=[(r,c) for r,c in coords if c==center]
for points, corner in [(left,0),(right,n-1)]:
    minr=min(r for r,c in points); maxr=max(r for r,c in points)
    minc=min(c for r,c in points); maxc=max(c for r,c in points)
    width=maxc-minc+1
    newc0=corner if corner==0 else n-width
    for r,c in points:
        out[r-minr][newc0+(c-minc)]=7
for r,c in mid: out[r][c]=7
maxr=max(r for r,c in mid)
for r in range(maxr+1):
    if out[r][center]!=7: out[r][center]=2
for r,row in enumerate(out): print(r, ' '.join(map(str,row)))
